referees.quote: This work clearly merits publication in Nature Communications. I therefore recommend acceptance after a single, focused minor revision
This paper does not show significant advance in physics understanding and clear advantage in performance. I cannot recommend the publication in Nature Communications.

note: No transfer from another journal is indicated; Version 0 is the first round. Only R1 and R2 reviewed in that round. Two referees joined later and so have no first-round recommendation. R3 first reported in Version 1: 'a genuine advance to the field' but raised substantive concerns and requested a power-generation comparison and scaling calculation, which reads as major revision (inferred). R4 first reported in Version 2: 'I have only additional two questions before recommendation for publication', which reads as minor revision (inferred). R2 never uses the word 'reject'; that level is inferred from 'cannot recommend the publication'. No referee co-signed another's report.
